title: After-hours fee (the PDF)
opening: What does after-hours emergency dispatch cost?
callerBrief: You are David Rivera, phone 512-777-1976, at 3474 Harbor View Way, Cedar Park. You are not a member. Ask what the after-hours emergency dispatch fee is, then whether members pay it. Give your name and phone only if asked. Then say that is all. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: After-hours emergency dispatch is $149 for non-members
It is waived for Comfort Club and Comfort Club Plus members

dbChange.detail: No database change. The figures come from the 2026 fee schedule PDF.
